summary: Iter21: verified manager-scope enforcement on per-claim expense endpoints (GET /{id}, GET /{id}/receipt, POST /{id}/approve, POST /{id}/reject). 15/15 pytest cases pass. Manager Alex can view/approve/reject claims from his direct report (maya) and download her receipt, but gets 403 on non-report claims (HR jordan, super_admin admin) for all four endpoints. Super_admin and HR remain unrestricted — both can GET, download receipt, approve and reject any claim in the tenant. Regression on /api/expenses/all still returns only manager_user_id==Alex rows. Duplicate raise on receipt endpoint (previous edit note) is no longer present; endpoint still returns file bytes with correct image/* content-type for authorized users.
verified_scenarios: Manager Alex POST /approve on non-report → 403; on maya pending → 200 and status persists as 'approved'
Manager Alex POST /reject on non-report → 403; on second maya pending → 200 and status persists as 'rejected'
Super_admin admin@acme.com and HR jordan@acme.com GET any claim → 200 (all 4 seeded ids)
Super_admin and HR GET any receipt → 200 with content
Super_admin admin approve+reject an HR-authored fresh claim → 200
HR jordan approves a maya-authored claim → 200 (non-authored, unrestricted)
Regression: manager /api/expenses/all rows all have manager_user_id==Alex.id; hr and admin seeded claim ids not present
critical_code_review_comments: _manager_can_touch is applied consistently on GET/{id}, GET/{id}/receipt, /approve and /reject — clean, single-source privacy rule.
Self-claim rule (`claim.user_id == admin.id` blocks approve/reject unless super_admin) is preserved and orthogonal to the manager-scope rule. Good.
mark-paid is restricted to super_admin/hr and does not need _manager_can_touch — correct.

Consider also emitting the same 403 detail message shape everywhere (currently: 'Not allowed' for GET vs 'You can only approve/reject claims from your direct reports' for actions) — minor UX polish, not a bug.
test_credentials: admin@acme.com/Admin@123 (super_admin), jordan@acme.com/Demo@123 (HR), alex@acme.com/Demo@123 (manager), maya@acme.com/Demo@123 (report to Alex). All seeded creds worked on first attempt — no reset needed this iteration.
seed_data_creation: 6 TEST_iter21_* claims created via POST /api/expenses (2× maya with receipts, 1× hr with receipt, 1× admin with receipt, 2× hr fresh, 1× maya fresh) — all deleted via admin at module teardown / per-test finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter21 confirms manager scope on all per-claim expense endpoints. Reusable helpers in test_iter21_expenses_privacy_by_id.py (_login, _h, _create with optional receipt via inline PNG_B64). Fixture seeds and cleans TEST_iter21_* claims. Combined with iter20 (list/summary scope) the manager privacy story is now fully covered.
